none: PAS NLM-E90803: Roman Nummus of Magnentius or Decentius
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus. Possibly of Magnentius (350-353) or Decentius (350-353). Coin possibly clipped. Obverse description: Bust facing right. Obverse inscription: (---)TIVS(---). Reverse description: Two victories holding inscribed shield between them. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 14.73mm, Weight: 1.26gms, die axis: 6
